subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Engajar-se e contribuir com a busca de conclusões comuns relativas a problemas, temas ou questões polêmicas de interesse da turma e/ou de relevância social.

components.description_pt: Engajar respeitosamente em discussões colaborativas sobre tópicos controversos ou socialmente relevantes
components.description_en: Engage respectfully in collaborative discussions about controversial or socially relevant topics
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules for collaborative discussions to engage productively with diverse partners

components.description_pt: Contribuir argumentos ou evidências que avancem um grupo rumo a uma conclusão compartilhada
components.description_en: Contribute arguments or evidence that advance a group toward a shared conclusion
components.cc_component_description: Draw a conclusion supported by information and perspectives shared in a group discussion

components.description_pt: Avaliar contribuições de pares para refinar uma posição coletiva sobre questão debatida
components.description_en: Evaluate peers' contributions to refine a collective position on a debated issue
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate whether new information presented by others warrants a change in one's own position

cc_matches.description: Review the key ideas expressed and draw conclusions in light of information and knowledge gained from the discussions.
Acknowledge new information expressed by others and, when warranted, modify their own views.

Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 5 topics and texts, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
